pages.text: Use checkpoints in the order the compass gives. The first closes the party to new arrivals.
pages.title: Settled marks
Settle the mark
pages.text: Each settled mark banks part of the guaranteed reward for every member. Those secured tokens survive a failed expedition. Extraction settles the remainder and any earned bonuses.

pages.title: Settle the mark
pages.text: Activation can draw company. Leave yourself room to move before touching the instrument.

pages.title: An unfinished route
pages.text: Death removes a member from the expedition; losing the last member ends it. Already banked tokens remain yours.

pages.title: An unfinished route
pages.text: Disconnecting leaves an unfinished route for later recovery, provided its markers still exist. Reaching the final checkpoint is not extraction. Follow the compass back to the exit and use it.
